product.title: Deluxe ATV Waterfall and Swim Experience

description.text: Spend time exploring the Big Island’s Hamakua Coast on this off-road excursion accessible from Kona-side itineraries. Enjoy complimentary lessons on a practice track if needed, then cruise along picturesque coastal trails on 4x4 Honda ATVs or UTVs. Stops include Practice Track, Hamakua Coast Trails, Mauna Kea Viewpoint, Waterfall Swim Stop. Enjoy magnificent views of Mauna Kea and the Pacific Ocean, stop at scenic spots for memorable photos, and cool off with a waterfall swim when conditions allow. Ideal for visitors basing in Kona who want a guided island experience without coordinating transport, gear, or park logistics on their own.
